blocks.text: Do testes pait (abdomen) ke bahar jild ki ek theli mein hote hain jise scrotum kehte hain. Har testis anda-numa (oval) hai, taqreeban 3–5 cm lamba aur 2–3 cm chaura. Testis bohat zyada bal khayi hui (highly convoluted) seminiferous tubules se bana hai. In tubules ki deewar, yani germinal epithelium, mein do qism ke cells hote hain: germline cells aur Sertoli cells. Germline cells meiosis se sperms (spermatozoa) banate hain, aur Sertoli cells banne wale sperms ko ghiza dete hain.

blocks.alt: (a) Mardana pelvis baghal se: peshab ka bladder, us ke peeche rectum aur aage pubic bone; bladder ke neeche prostate gland; bladder ke peeche seminal vesicle; scrotum ke testis aur epididymis se vas deferens oopar ja kar bladder ke oopar se guzarti aur seminal vesicle ki nali se mil kar prostate mein ejaculatory duct banti hai; prostate ke neeche bulbourethral gland; penis mein se guzarti urethra. (b) Khula hua testis: lobules mein seminiferous tubules, rete testis, epididymis aur vas deferens.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sperm ka rasta khaake mein dhoondein: seminiferous tubules (b) se rete testis, phir epididymis, phir vas deferens jo oopar ja kar bladder ke oopar se ghoomti hai, phir seminal vesicle ki nali se mil kar ejaculatory duct, jo prostate ke andar urethra mein khulti hai, aur urethra penis se bahar. Kitab ki tasveer mein label 'Urethera' chhapa hai; sahih hijje (spelling) 'Urethra' hai, jo hamare khaake mein likha hai.
